_comment: Wasmtime-parity skip-list for `scripts/diff-testsuite-reports.py` (issue #583 C1). Each entry is a `wasm32-wasip3` fixture wamr currently passes but wasmtime fails, downgraded to a *documented* delta (warned, but does not fail the parity gate). Add an entry only with a tracking URL for the upstream wasmtime / wasi-testsuite bug that explains the failure; the gate fails if a listed fixture is no longer in the wamr-pass / parity-fail shape (e.g. the upstream fix landed — drop the entry). Keys starting with `_` are reserved for inline documentation. Keyed by fixture name (matches `<fixture>.wasm` under `tests/wasi-testsuite/tests/rust/testsuite/wasm32-wasip3/`).
http-service: tracking https://github.com/WebAssembly/wasi-testsuite/issues/228 — test-runner's URL concat produces `//` when wasmtime serve prints `Serving HTTP on http://X:Y/` (trailing slash) and the request path is `/`
sockets-tcp-connect: tracking https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasmtime/issues/13396 — `test_explicit_bind_addrinuse` (`src/bin/sockets-tcp-connect.rs:142`) — second bind to a held ephemeral port does not return `ErrorCode::AddressInUse`
sockets-tcp-listen: tracking https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasmtime/issues/13397 — `test_inherited_properties` (`src/bin/sockets-tcp-listen.rs:23`) — accepted socket's `get-send-buffer-size` differs from listener (Linux `tcp_wmem` autotune)
sockets-udp-send: tracking https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasmtime/issues/13398 — `test_wrong_address_family` (`src/bin/sockets-udp-send.rs:12`) — UDP `send` to wrong-family address does not return `ErrorCode::InvalidArgument`
